entries.name: M4A1
entries.summary: A modular 5.56mm rifle with automatic and semi-automatic fire. Shares magazines with the M4, M16A4, SCAR-L and AR416A5.
details: Found in supply boxes, weapon crates and the Replicator.
Accepts optics, muzzles, pistol grips and stocks. The standard magazine holds 30 rounds.
Damage is undocumented in the cited wiki page. Shop prices are snapshots checked 2026-09-18; no M4A1 shop price is documented.

entries.name: MP5
entries.summary: A compact 9x19mm submachine gun with automatic and semi-automatic modes, a dedicated 30-round magazine and a suppressor option.
details: Found in supply boxes, weapon crates and on Turned Soldiers.
Damage is undocumented in the cited wiki page. Shop prices are snapshots checked 2026-09-18.

entries.name: AK-103

Damage is undocumented in the cited wiki page. Shop prices are snapshots checked 2026-09-18.

entries.name: PKM
